screen_scope: only the original sixteen seeds and four indices; stop at first eligible candidate

case.program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (dist-from start)
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list start))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (bfs)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let* ((p (first queue)) (r (first p)) (c (second p)) (d0 (hash-ref dist p)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 5))
                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (list nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! dist (list nr nc) (+ d0 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc)))))))
            (bfs))))
      (bfs)
      dist)
    (define colors (list 2 3 4))
    (define dists (map (lambda (color) (list color (dist-from (first (find-color g color))))) colors))
    (define (out-color color) (cond [(= color 2) 6] [(= color 3) 7] [else 8]))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (not (= (at g r c) 0))
            (at g r c)
            (let* ((p (list r c))
                   (vals (filter (lambda (cd) (hash-has-key? (second cd) p)) dists)))
              (if (empty? vals)
                  0
                  (let* ((mind (apply min (map (lambda (cd) (hash-ref (second cd) p)) vals)))
                         (winners (filter (lambda (cd) (= (hash-ref (second cd) p) mind)) vals)))
                    (if (> (length winners) 1) 9 (out-color (first (first winners))))))))))))
